entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return my new VeloBand. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the device?
It's just... it's really hard to use. I read the user manual, but everything is so confusing. I honestly expected more from it. It's not intuitive at all.
I understand that can be frustrating when a new product doesn't meet your expectations. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay. I really hope I can return it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while, and I really needed this money back for some other things. I feel bad for even asking.

I understand completely. Okay, I have your order here. It looks like it was delivered 12 days ago. Let's see... yes, you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process that for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. I am emailing you a prepaid return shipping label as we speak. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Just attach that to the original packaging and drop it off at the post office.
That sounds easy enough. When will I get my refund?
Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that was it. Have a good one.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
